info.description: Public, store-scoped catalog API for storefront themes. Additive changes only within v1. Select the store with X-Store (or the store domain), the locale with Accept-Language or ?locale=, the currency with X-Currency. Account routes take a customer access token (Authorization: Bearer); catalog routes accept it optionally for group prices.
